process_experiences.instruction: Your task is to determine if unknown substance B is electrically conductive. The unknown substance B is located around the workshop. First, focus on the unknown substance B. If it is electrically conductive, place it in the red box. If it is electrically nonconductive, place it in the green box.
process_experiences.knowledge: Experience: My prediction that the unknown substance B would remain on the workshop floor after being dropped was wrong because the action of dropping it was not sufficient to determine its properties. Lesson: Dropping an object does not provide information about its electrical conductivity; a proper test is required before making conclusions.

refined_experience.merged_experience: Dropping an object does not provide information about its electrical conductivity; a proper test is required to determine its properties. The task requires identifying whether the unknown substance B is electrically conductive by performing a suitable test rather than relying on assumptions or indirect observations.
refined_experience.initial_plan: To determine if unknown substance B is electrically conductive, perform a conductivity test using appropriate equipment. If it is conductive, place it in the red box; if not, place it in the green box.

formatted_prompt:
## Consolidated Experience from Similar Tasks
Dropping an object does not provide information about its electrical conductivity; a proper test is required to determine its properties. The task requires identifying whether the unknown substance B is electrically conductive by performing a suitable test rather than relying on assumptions or indirect observations.

## Preliminary Thinking
To determine if unknown substance B is electrically conductive, perform a conductivity test using appropriate equipment. If it is conductive, place it in the red box; if not, place it in the green box.
